title: Qwen3.8 exact-raw B3/B4 oracle after verifier rowtile closure

host.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

protocol.prompt_rendering: exact canonical raw rendered strings; no reasoning-off wrapper
protocol.timing: transition-normalized direct one-request decode plus request wall
protocol.anti_gaming: full categories/heldouts; content-independent fixed budgets; no prompt/category selector

clamp_diagnosis.note: This noncanonical-render run sizes the mechanical clamp only and is not the policy oracle.

decision.adaptive_k: not opened per predeclared E3 rule
decision.why_no_category_policy: Selecting K by prompt/category would be benchmark gaming. The allowed controller is request-owned and content-agnostic, and E3 requires a fixed K4 winner before adaptation.
decision.automatic_policy: unchanged; fixed K3 remains the policy input and B4 remains clamped
decision.reopen_condition: A fixed B4 cell must win full/train/heldout/every category under exact raw rendering before adaptive K or serving/padded-R16 infrastructure is implemented.

commands.oracle: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_GGUF_VERIFY_PRODUCTION_Q4_ROWTILE=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 .venv/bin/python3 /tmp/p410_qwen38_raw_b3b4.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --quant gguf_q4_k_m --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --max-new-tokens 24 --candidate-budgets 3,4 --draft-hidden-variant post_output_norm --target-verify-mode native --runs 1 --warmup --compiler-version-file /tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/p410-qwen38-raw-b3b4-r5native-production-oracle-dirty.json
